issues.description: The specification (task text + UML) requires a parameterless method `getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int`, but the solution implements `getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)`. This changes the required public API and will fail/contradict tests and student implementations expecting `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` with no parameters.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to provide `public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()` (no parameters) returning `numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents`, and update callers (`getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents`, `getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor`) to use the no-arg method. If the boolean behavior is desired, keep it only as an overload in addition to the required no-arg method.
